_meta.method: Web search against tournament-edition-specific sources (Wikipedia edition infoboxes primarily, cross-checked against ATP/WTA official history pages). No category defaults assumed - each entry individually source-checked per the standard set in WORKORDER_Phase1_DrawSize_Gap_Audit.md.
_meta.known_trap_flagged: WTA official 'Overview' pages (e.g. wtatennis.com/tournaments/{id}/{name}/{year}) sometimes serve generic/evergreen current-state copy on old-edition URLs and should NOT be used as the source of record - use the edition-specific Wikipedia article or the WTA/ATP draws archive PDF instead. Confirmed cases: WTA Rome 2022, WTA Toronto 2022.
